title: Define the OAuth/OIDC provider adapter architecture
summary: Defined a provider-neutral Identity adapter contract with immutable redacted values, protocol-specific Google OIDC and GitHub OAuth semantics, exact endpoint/redirect allowlists, bounded TLS HTTP behavior, deterministic failure fakes, side-effect-free stable-subject account resolution, and a provider addition runbook.
